mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (users_id, order_number, total_price, receiver_name, receiver_phone, address, payment_method, status, ordered_at) VALUES (#{usersId}, #{orderNumber}, #{totalPrice}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{address}, #{paymentMethod}, #{status}, now())
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT order_id, users_id, order_number, total_price, receiver_name, receiver_phone, address, payment_method, status, ordered_at FROM orders WHERE users_id = #{usersId} ORDER BY order_id DESC

SELECT oi.item_id, oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price, p.name AS product_name, p.img_emoji AS image FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
